services.name: Charter Details
services.desc: Fish Headz Sport Fishing Charters offers a spot to fish aboard either of their two inspected and approved charter fishing vessels. Offering charter fishing for Lake St. Clair, the Detroit and St. Clair rivers for smallmouth bass, muskie, walleye, perch and sturgeon. We operate a 5 boat charter fishing operation consisting of 3 NEW LUND boats over 20’ and 2 boats over 28’ to accommodate larger groups and handle bigger water. All of our charter boats are outfitted with the very best technology and equipment to ensure we do everything to put you on fish!
